master_axis: Master line of action: the sea and the returning ship sit FRAME RIGHT; the tower sits FRAME LEFT. WICK's journey runs frame RIGHT to LEFT. The climb runs vertically with the tower wall to the left. After the ignition the payoff looks back FRAME RIGHT to the sea. No shot crosses this axis without a neutral macro or POV buffer.
coverage: every shot in 02_SCREENPLAY/SHOT_LIST.json has exactly one plan entry

shots.composition: centre-weighted macro; the key is the entire frame
shots.camera_motion: locked-off. Motivation: nothing moves but the key, so the camera must not add motion.
shots.character_blocking: WICK off-frame; only her back plate and the turning key.
shots.lighting_intention: one warm practical raking the brass; everything else black | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Extreme macro. A brass winding key seated in a back plate. It turns - once, twice, three times. On the fourth turn the ratchet slips and the key overshoots with no bite.
shots.sound_intention: Three dry ratchet clicks, close and intimate. Distant wind under. No music.
shots.continuity_notes: First appearance of the key and back plate. The fourth-turn slip is the film's inciting incident and must read clearly at any size.

shots.composition: rule-of-thirds; the shearing tooth at an upper intersection
shots.camera_motion: very slight push-in. Motivation: the audience leans toward the failure.
shots.character_blocking: coil inside the drum; tooth shears and falls out of frame.
shots.lighting_intention: amber internal glow on the coil; the ping reads as a flash | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Macro on the glass chest drum. Inside, the coil tightens - then a single spring tooth shears off, pings against the glass and falls out of frame. The needle swings upward, hesitates, sags, and settles on 92.
shots.transition: Cut to a held static on the gauge.
shots.sound_intention: A bright metallic ping on the shear, then a low sub thud as the needle settles. Silence under.
shots.continuity_notes: 92 is established here at 00:08, inside the eight-second hook deadline. This exact needle position is the reference for every later gauge shot.

shots.composition: centred gauge; the number 92 dead-centre
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: the first true stillness lets the number land.
shots.character_blocking: needle settles; trembles once; still.
shots.lighting_intention: soft amber defocus over cool brass | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Hold on the gauge. 92. The needle trembles once and is still. Out of focus, warm amber lamp light drifts across the glass.
shots.sound_intention: Wind. Distant water. Nothing else. The silence is the point.
shots.continuity_notes: The amber defocus is the harbour lamp, established before we see it. Do not identify the source yet.

shots.composition: reveal: subject low-centre, vast negative space above
shots.camera_height: rising from her eye height to a high crane
shots.camera_angle: low to high in one move
shots.camera_motion: slow continuous crane back and up. Motivation: the world is the reveal; the move is the reveal.
shots.character_blocking: WICK stands alone, tiny, on the quay.
shots.background: drowned town, dusk sky, one burning lamp, tower on horizon frame L
shots.lighting_intention: dusk teal; the single amber lamp is the only warm source | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Slow pull back and up. The frame opens out to reveal WICK - forty centimetres of aged brass - alone on a barnacled stone quay. Behind her, a drowned harbour town. One lamp still burns on a post. Dusk.
shots.sound_intention: Harbour ambience swells in as we widen: water, wind through iron, no birds.
shots.continuity_notes: First full view of WICK and of the world. The single burning lamp must be in frame and clearly the only light source.

shots.composition: close, head-centred; eyes on the top third
shots.camera_motion: handheld micro-drift. Motivation: a living, breathing (ticking) machine.
shots.character_blocking: shutter eyes iris open; head drops to the chest gauge, then tilts up.
shots.lighting_intention: cool dusk with amber eye glow | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: WICK's shutter eyes open - the apertures irising up from black. She looks down at her own chest gauge, and holds on what it says.
shots.transition: Cut to her point of view.
shots.sound_intention: Her clock motif, first statement: three thin notes on a single instrument. Wind.
shots.continuity_notes: The shutter-eye open is her first expression and sets the vocabulary for the whole film. Aperture range established here is reused for every later emotional beat.

shots.composition: her POV; tower small at the left-third horizon line
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: it is her gaze, not a camera idea.
shots.character_blocking: WICK off-frame (POV).
shots.background: unlit tower frame L, bruised sky
shots.lighting_intention: last dusk; tower a black silhouette | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Her point of view: the dark, unlit beacon tower on the horizon across black water. Hold. She does not move.
shots.sound_intention: Wind. The clock motif does not resolve; it simply stops.
shots.continuity_notes: First view of the tower from her perspective. Bearing and water line must match SC02_SH004, which shoots it from the opposite side.

shots.composition: low medium; the pillar looms over her, apex off-frame
shots.camera_height: ankle-height of a human / her full height
shots.camera_angle: low, tilting her small against the pillar
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: the habit is the point; no motion needed.
shots.character_blocking: she backs to the pillar and seats herself - a daily, practised motion.
shots.lighting_intention: dusk teal; pillar unlit | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: WICK at the winding pillar, a brass column at the centre of the plaza. She backs up to it and raises herself onto the socket - a practised, habitual, daily motion.
shots.transition: Cut to macro on the socket.
shots.sound_intention: Her joints. The small click of alignment as she seats herself.
shots.continuity_notes: The pillar is the same asset seen in the SC01 wide. Her approach must read as habitual, not exploratory.

shots.composition: macro socket centred; the worn teeth on the lower third
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: the repetition of the failure is the content; the camera gives no help.
shots.character_blocking: key enters, spins free; she withdraws; tries again; and again.
shots.lighting_intention: raking warm key-light on worn teeth | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Macro on the socket: stripped, the teeth worn away. The key enters and spins free with no bite. She withdraws and tries again. And again.
shots.sound_intention: Three hollow spins with no ratchet underneath. On the third, absolute silence.
shots.continuity_notes: The stripped socket is permanent. No later scene may imply the pillar can be repaired.

shots.composition: extreme long lens; the running light a point on the right-third
shots.camera_distance: very long (200mm) - the sea frame RIGHT
shots.camera_motion: held. Motivation: the ship is distant and slow; motion would falsify it.
shots.character_blocking: off-frame (her eyeline).
shots.background: sea frame R, reef line, single amber light
shots.lighting_intention: storm-grey sea; one amber point | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Wide over the harbour to the horizon. A single amber running light, low on the water, moving toward the reef line.
shots.sound_intention: Wind. A distant bell buoy, slow and irregular. First statement of the ship's motif: two descending notes.
shots.continuity_notes: The ship is never seen closer than this until SC09. Reef line position must match SC09_SH002 exactly.

shots.composition: wide; tower leans from the left edge, sky dominant
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: let the height be felt, not pushed.
shots.character_blocking: off-frame.
shots.background: tower full height frame L, bruised sky
shots.lighting_intention: storm slate rim | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Reverse, from the waterline: the beacon tower, black against a bruised sky, unlit.
shots.sound_intention: Wind rising. Iron groaning under load.
shots.continuity_notes: This is the first view of the tower's full height. The plating and handholds seen here are the same ones climbed in SC07.

shots.composition: close; gauge lower-third, tower reflected in the lenses above
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: the reflection completes the three-point eyeline.
shots.character_blocking: she holds still; the tower lives in her lenses.
shots.background: tower reflection in the shutter lenses
shots.lighting_intention: amber eye/chest glow over cool brass | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Close on WICK's chest. The gauge reads 92. The dark tower is reflected in her shutter lenses.
shots.sound_intention: Her clock motif, second statement - noticeably faster than the first.
shots.continuity_notes: The three-point eyeline is ship / tower / own chest. This shot is the third point and must contain the tower reflection to complete it.

shots.composition: medium profile; she crosses and exits frame L on the footfall
shots.camera_motion: static; she provides the motion and exits frame L. Motivation: cut on the step, not after it.
shots.character_blocking: lifts the pole, shoulders it, takes one step frame L.
shots.lighting_intention: dusk; last warm lamp behind | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: She reaches down and lifts the lamp-pole from the stone. It is taller than she is. She sets it against her shoulder, takes one step toward the tower.
shots.sound_intention: The pole scraping stone. One footfall. Then the score's first forward motion underneath.
shots.continuity_notes: The pole leaves with her here and is not lost until SC05_SH003. Its length relative to her body must stay consistent.

shots.composition: lateral tracking; gauge held in frame as she moves R->L
shots.camera_motion: lateral dolly at her height, matching her stride. Motivation: keep the gauge legible while she travels.
shots.character_blocking: walks frame L; gauge ticks with each stride.
shots.lighting_intention: dusk teal; warm practicals sparse | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Lateral tracking. WICK crosses the plaza. With every stride the gauge ticks down: 92, 90, 88.
shots.sound_intention: Ratchet ticks locked to her footfalls. This is the film's central sound idea and it starts here.
shots.continuity_notes: The tick-to-footfall sync must be exact - it is the grammar the rest of the film relies on. Gauge decrements in even steps.

shots.composition: centred insert; identical gauge framing to SC01_SH003
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: locked insert grammar.
shots.character_blocking: needle steps 88->86.
shots.lighting_intention: soft amber on the dial | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Insert on the gauge. 88 to 86. The needle moves in discrete, audible steps rather than smoothly.
shots.sound_intention: Two ticks, loud and dry, with nothing under them.
shots.continuity_notes: Gauge insert framing is now locked: same lens, same angle, same lighting key for every insert in the film.

shots.composition: high crane; the drowned town fills frame, WICK small lower-third
shots.camera_motion: high crane, slow push. Motivation: the beauty pass is earned by height and patience.
shots.character_blocking: walks away from camera, small.
shots.lighting_intention: the film's one warm, calm light | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Wide. The drowned harbour in full: barnacled arches, kelp swaying in the shallows, rooftops under black water. Beautiful, and completely empty.
shots.sound_intention: The music opens out: strings, warm, the only major-key passage in the film.
shots.continuity_notes: This is the beauty pass. It exists so the audience has something to lose. Kelp and water motion must be gentle here and violent from SC05.

shots.composition: medium tracking; lamp posts strobe the foreground
shots.camera_motion: tracking; foreground poles strobe past. Motivation: rhythm and the row of dead lamps.
shots.character_blocking: walks frame L past dead lamps; one burns behind.
shots.lighting_intention: cool with a single warm lamp behind | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: She passes a row of harbour lamp posts, all dead. She does not stop. Behind her, the one lamp that still burns.
shots.sound_intention: The clock motif continues under the strings. Wind.
shots.continuity_notes: The dead lamps foreshadow what the beacon will fix. The one burning lamp is the source of the spark she takes in SC05.

shots.composition: over-shoulder; black water ahead fills the frame
shots.camera_motion: static hold on the water. Motivation: the water is the next obstacle; let it be seen.
shots.character_blocking: stops at the quay edge, back to camera.
shots.lighting_intention: music cuts; water catches cold light | scene key: cold teal, one warm practical
shots.action: Gauge reads 84. She reaches the edge of the plaza. Beyond it, the street is black water.
shots.sound_intention: Music cuts out entirely. Water lapping at stone.
shots.continuity_notes: 84 is the handoff value into SC04. The street water level established here must match SC04_SH001.

shots.composition: wide low; water fills the lower half, she at the right edge
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: the flood is the reveal.
shots.character_blocking: stops at the lane edge.
shots.lighting_intention: storm slate, flat cold | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: Wide, low. The flooded lane. For a forty-centimetre machine this is a flood. She stops at the edge.
shots.sound_intention: Water. Wind funnelling between buildings.
shots.continuity_notes: Water level must match SC03_SH005. This is the same lane, seen from the other side.

shots.composition: tight at her height on the stall climb
shots.camera_motion: handheld instability. Motivation: the effort should feel unstable.
shots.character_blocking: grip, haul, grip up the stall.
shots.lighting_intention: cold with her amber chest glow | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: She climbs a submerged market stall. Grip, haul, grip. Water sheets off her. Gauge 84 to 80.
shots.sound_intention: Metal straining. Water sheeting off brass. The footfall ticks continue but are now irregular.
shots.continuity_notes: First irregular tick. From here the rhythm degrades progressively and never fully recovers.

shots.composition: profile; the railing a hard horizontal line, she above it
shots.camera_motion: static profile; she crosses. Motivation: the line gives the traverse legibility.
shots.character_blocking: hand-over-hand along the railing.
shots.lighting_intention: first countable raindrops catch light | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: Railing traverse, hand over hand. Rain begins - sparse first drops on the water. Gauge 80 to 77.
shots.sound_intention: Rhythmic clicks. The first raindrops - distinct, countable.
shots.continuity_notes: Rain starts here and never stops until SC09. First drops must be individually audible.

shots.composition: underwater; the bright surface as a ceiling above
shots.camera_motion: goes under with her. Motivation: the drop must be felt, not observed.
shots.character_blocking: grip fails; she falls; bubbles rise.
shots.lighting_intention: muffled; surface a bright ceiling | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: THE DROP. Her grip fails and she goes under. Bubbles. The gauge flickers, the needle stuttering. The surface becomes a bright ceiling above her.
shots.sound_intention: Everything muffles. A dull sub. Her clock motif distorted and slowing.
shots.continuity_notes: The muffled sound world is used only here and in SH005. The needle flicker is the first sign the water has done real damage.

shots.composition: low underwater looking up at her amber eyes
shots.camera_motion: static low; she rises past. Motivation: her glow is the only warm thing in the murk.
shots.character_blocking: plants feet, pushes up.
shots.lighting_intention: amber eye glow in teal murk | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: Underwater, looking up. Her shutter eyes glow amber in the murk. She plants her feet on the lane floor and pushes.
shots.sound_intention: Muffled. Then the first audible catch of her spring - a small bright note under the murk.
shots.continuity_notes: The amber eye glow underwater is a signature image; keep the aperture half-closed so it reads as effort, not calm.

shots.composition: tight low; she breaks the surface and hauls onto the coping
shots.camera_motion: low and tight; water on the lens. Motivation: imperfect on purpose - she is damaged.
shots.character_blocking: breaks surface, hauls onto coping, sparking.
shots.lighting_intention: steam off brass; rain steady | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: She breaks the surface and hauls herself onto a wall coping, sparking. Steam comes off her brass. Gauge 75 to 71.
shots.sound_intention: The surface break, loud. Rain now steady and continuous.
shots.continuity_notes: The shoulder joint sparks here and again in SC07_SH004. Same joint, so the damage is continuous, not incidental.

shots.composition: wide; the gantry a diagonal across frame, tower at its far (L) end
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: the destination must stay visible during the obstacle.
shots.character_blocking: steps onto the gantry.
shots.lighting_intention: storm slate; wind from camera-R | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: Wide. The gantry walkway spans the lane, rusted and swaying in the rising wind. She steps onto it.
shots.sound_intention: Wind up sharply. Iron creaking under load.
shots.continuity_notes: The tower must be visible at the gantry's far end so the destination stays present during the obstacle.

shots.composition: medium low; wind from camera-R bends the rain horizontal
shots.camera_motion: static; the gust supplies motion. Motivation: brace against, don't chase.
shots.character_blocking: braces, pole horizontal.
shots.screen_direction: holds frame L against wind R
shots.lighting_intention: cold steel; spark glow | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: Midway. A gust hits. She braces with the pole held horizontal. Gauge 71 to 68.
shots.sound_intention: The gust as a solid wall of sound, not a whoosh.
shots.continuity_notes: Wind direction is camera-right for the whole scene. The pole is horizontal here and leaves her hand in the next shot.

shots.composition: follow the pole out of frame; hold on empty water
shots.camera_motion: follows the pole out of frame, then holds on the water. Motivation: the loss is the subject; the absence is held.
shots.character_blocking: gust takes the pole; she reaches for nothing.
shots.screen_direction: pole exits; she is left frame R of centre
shots.lighting_intention: the hole in the sound matches the hole in the frame | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: THE POLE GOES. A second gust takes the lamp-pole out of her grip. It spins away, strikes the water and is gone.
shots.sound_intention: The pole clattering on iron, one splash, then nothing. A hole opens in the sound.
shots.continuity_notes: CRITICAL CONTINUITY: the pole is gone from here until SC07_SH005, where it is found wedged in the tower ironwork. It must not appear in SC05_SH004 through SC07_SH004.

shots.composition: close static; the whole decision in one frame
shots.camera_motion: static, no cut. Motivation: the stillness IS the beat; wind drops for it.
shots.character_blocking: looks at empty hand; looks at the tower; decides.
shots.lighting_intention: the only quiet in the storm | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: She stands without it. Looks at her empty hand. Looks at the tower. Decides. The wind drops for one beat.
shots.sound_intention: The wind drops for exactly one beat. The only quiet in the storm.
shots.continuity_notes: No gauge cost here. The stillness is the point; the audience must be allowed to register the loss.

shots.composition: macro; the signature image - amber spark behind rain-streaked glass
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: protect the image; let it be looked at.
shots.character_blocking: opens the chest drum; the spark glows; she seals the glass.
shots.lighting_intention: the spark is the warmest thing in the scene | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: She opens her chest drum. Inside: a live spark, taken from the last burning harbour lamp. She closes the glass against the rain.
shots.sound_intention: The glass sealing. A small warm hum begins - the spark's own tone, which persists until SC08_SH003.
shots.continuity_notes: The spark is now a permanent element of every shot until SC08. Its hum is the film's second leitmotif.

shots.composition: tracking; the glow the brightest element
shots.camera_motion: tracking; the glow leads the frame. Motivation: the thing she shields is the light source.
shots.character_blocking: moves frame L, one arm across the chest.
shots.lighting_intention: amber glow vs cold steel | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: She moves on, one arm now curled across her chest to shield the glass. The spark is drawing power as she walks. Gauge 64 to 60.
shots.sound_intention: The spark hum plus a new, slower tick layered over the footfall ticks - the drain is audible.
shots.continuity_notes: From here she carries the pole-less silhouette: one arm across the chest. This posture is held until SC08.

shots.composition: macro gauge, then rack to the door - one move
shots.camera_motion: rack focus gauge->door. Motivation: hand SC06 its first image in a single move.
shots.character_blocking: off-frame walking.
shots.lighting_intention: rain; door dark | scene key: storm slate, deep teal, amber spark
shots.action: Gauge insert: 60 to 58. Rack focus past the needle to the tower door ahead through the rain.
shots.sound_intention: Rain. The spark hum continues.
shots.continuity_notes: The rack focus hands SC06 its first image. Door position and water level must match SC06_SH001.

shots.composition: wide low; the swollen door fills the frame above her
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: compress her against the bottom edge.
shots.character_blocking: stands at the foot of the door, small.
shots.lighting_intention: rain on iron; tower humming | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: The tower door: iron, swollen, barnacled. She stands at its foot. She is very small against it.
shots.sound_intention: Rain on iron. The tower itself humming in the wind.
shots.continuity_notes: Same door seen in the SC05_SH007 rack focus. Barnacle pattern and water line must match.

shots.composition: tight on the effort, then whip to the gauge
shots.camera_motion: tight, then a whip to the gauge. Motivation: the single fast move of the film is the cost.
shots.character_blocking: shoulder to the plate; it gives; she resets; it swings.
shots.lighting_intention: her glow + cold iron | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: She levers it. Shoulder against the plate. It gives an inch. She resets and pushes again. It swings. Gauge falls fast: 58 to 49 to 40.
shots.sound_intention: Iron shrieking. Her spring straining - a sound not used anywhere else.
shots.continuity_notes: Eighteen turns, the largest single cost. The needle must be seen crossing 49 on the way down so the arithmetic is legible.

shots.composition: centred insert; the needle crossing into the red arc
shots.camera_motion: dead still. Motivation: the quietest moment in the film.
shots.character_blocking: needle crosses into the red arc.
shots.lighting_intention: everything drops out except needle friction | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: Gauge insert. The needle crosses into the RED ARC of the dial. Hold.
shots.sound_intention: Everything drops out except the tiny friction of the needle. The quietest moment in the film.
shots.continuity_notes: The red arc is introduced HERE and not at the climax, so the colour can do the worrying for us afterwards.

shots.composition: interior; she enters low, the stair tilts up out of frame
shots.camera_motion: she enters; tilt up the stair, and keep tilting. Motivation: the tower's height in one move.
shots.character_blocking: steps in; her glow lights the stair.
shots.lighting_intention: her glow is the ONLY light | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: Interior. She steps in. A spiral stair rises into darkness, lit only by her own amber glow. Water runs down the inside of the wall.
shots.transition: Cut to the top of the stair.
shots.sound_intention: Her footsteps echo. Reverb opens up hard the moment she crosses the threshold.
shots.continuity_notes: Her chest glow is the only light in the tower interior from here to SC08. The reverb change marks the interior/exterior boundary.

shots.composition: POV across the gap, then back to her
shots.camera_motion: POV then reverse, two angles, no motion. Motivation: the gap is the information.
shots.character_blocking: at the broken stair edge.
shots.lighting_intention: storm light through the breach | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: The stair ends. A gap. Broken iron hanging. Beyond it, the wall - and through a breach, the storm outside. Gauge 35 to 31.
shots.sound_intention: Wind coming through the breach. The reverb narrows.
shots.continuity_notes: The gap is why she must go outside. The breach framing here must match SC07_SH001 so the exit is legible.

shots.composition: extreme wide; the tower a vertical line, sea white far below
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: she is a speck on a vertical; scale is the shot.
shots.character_blocking: flattens against the iron as the gale hits.
shots.screen_direction: on the wall; climb begins up/left
shots.lighting_intention: storm-white rim | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: She goes out through the breach onto the riveted plating. The gale hits her flat. She presses herself against the iron. Gauge 31 to 28.
shots.sound_intention: The gale at full volume. Rain horizontal.
shots.continuity_notes: First exterior since SC02_SH004. Plating and rivet pattern must match that establishing shot exactly.

shots.composition: follow the iron down, hold on empty air
shots.camera_motion: follows the stair section down out of frame; holds on the void. Motivation: the last easy option leaves.
shots.character_blocking: watches it go.
shots.lighting_intention: storm | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: The remaining section of stair tears away from the tower and falls. She watches it go. Gauge 28 to 25.
shots.sound_intention: The crash, delayed and far below. Then wind.
shots.continuity_notes: The stair is destroyed. No later shot may show intact stair. This is the point of no return.

shots.composition: rising track; the horizon progressively tilts off-level
shots.camera_motion: slow rising track matched to her climb. Motivation: height felt, not shown.
shots.character_blocking: hand over hand on rivets.
shots.lighting_intention: storm rim; her glow | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: The climb. Hand over hand on rivets. Rain. The horizon tilts as she gains height. Gauge 25 to 22.
shots.sound_intention: Grab, strain, grab. Her gait rhythm now audibly irregular - the pattern established in SC04_SH002 continues to degrade.
shots.continuity_notes: Longest single shot in the film at 8 seconds, placed at the point of maximum investment. The tilted horizon must be consistent through SH008.

shots.composition: long lens straight down the drop
shots.camera_motion: reveal the drop with a long lens. Motivation: the height is the danger.
shots.character_blocking: peeled off; swings on one arm.
shots.lighting_intention: storm | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: GRIP LOSS. A gust peels her off the iron. She swings on one arm over the drop. Gauge 22 to 20.
shots.sound_intention: One long metallic scream from the shoulder joint. Music out entirely.
shots.continuity_notes: Same shoulder joint as SC04_SH006. The damage is cumulative and must be animated as a weakness, not a new injury.

shots.composition: insert: the wedged pole, then her hand closing on it
shots.camera_motion: insert then her hand - two frames, no exposition. Motivation: the earlier loss pays off mechanically.
shots.character_blocking: free hand finds the wedged pole; closes on it.
shots.lighting_intention: a single bright note returns | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: Her free hand closes on something: the lamp-pole, wedged in the ironwork. It came up the tower with the storm.
shots.sound_intention: A single bright note. The score returns, one instrument only.
shots.continuity_notes: CRITICAL CONTINUITY: this is the pole lost in SC05_SH003. Its position wedged in the ironwork must be plausible - it was blown against the tower, not placed.

shots.composition: tight on the haul; the gauge kept in the corner of frame
shots.camera_motion: tight; the gauge rides the corner. Motivation: the cost must be visible during the win.
shots.character_blocking: uses the pole as a brace; hauls.
shots.lighting_intention: storm rim | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: She uses the pole as a brace and hauls herself back onto the iron. Gauge 20 to 14.
shots.sound_intention: The strain. Her clock motif stuttering - now audibly skipping a note.
shots.continuity_notes: The skipped note in the motif is the audio signature of a weakening spring and worsens through SH008.

shots.composition: abstract tight: brass, rivets, rain - the world reduced
shots.camera_motion: very tight, almost abstract. Motivation: hold on the broken motion, don't cover it.
shots.character_blocking: limbs stutter; drags herself.
shots.lighting_intention: near-monochrome | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: The last stretch. Her limbs stutter. The gait breaks down entirely - she is dragging herself upward. Gauge 14 to 9.
shots.sound_intention: The mechanism audibly failing. Metal fatigue. The clock motif has stopped being a melody.
shots.continuity_notes: The animation degradation is the storytelling here. Do not cover it with cutting - hold on the broken motion.

shots.composition: medium held; she collapses over the rail into the lee
shots.camera_motion: she collapses into frame; hold. Motivation: let her be still before cutting.
shots.character_blocking: pulls herself over the rail; collapses.
shots.lighting_intention: gale drops inside the lee | scene key: near-monochrome, high contrast, storm-white rim
shots.action: She reaches the gallery rail and pulls herself over, collapsing into the lee. Gauge 9 to 6. The burner chamber door is ahead.
shots.sound_intention: The gale drops sharply as she gets into the lee of the gallery.
shots.continuity_notes: Six turns remain entering SC08. The red arc is fully engaged; it must read clearly even in this low, wet framing.

shots.composition: wide; she is tiny in an enormous brass room
shots.camera_motion: static. Motivation: scale contrast is the whole shot.
shots.character_blocking: at the foot of the burner, tiny.
shots.lighting_intention: her glow the only light | scene key: black to full amber
shots.action: Interior, the burner chamber. Cold, enormous brass. Her glow is the only light in it. She is tiny.
shots.sound_intention: The storm reduced to a murmur outside. Water dripping.
shots.continuity_notes: Scale contrast is the whole point of this shot. Her glow must be the only light source in frame.

shots.composition: close following her hands up the last rungs
shots.camera_motion: close, following the hands, unhurried. Motivation: it is not an action beat.
shots.character_blocking: climbs; opens the chest; lifts the spark out.
shots.lighting_intention: exposed spark glow | scene key: black to full amber
shots.action: She climbs the last few rungs to the burner, opens her chest and lifts the spark out. Gauge 6 to 3.
shots.sound_intention: The spark's hum, now exposed and fragile without the glass around it.
shots.continuity_notes: The chest goes dark here. Every shot from SC05_SH005 has had the glow; its absence is a deliberate visual loss.

shots.composition: tight on the spark and the cold brass; the gap is the subject
shots.camera_motion: static tight. Motivation: the gap between spark and brass is the point.
shots.character_blocking: offers the spark; nothing catches; tries again.
shots.lighting_intention: fragile glow on dead brass | scene key: black to full amber
shots.action: She offers the spark to the burner. Nothing catches. She repositions and tries again. Nothing.
shots.sound_intention: The hum, then silence. No catch. No click. Nothing.
shots.continuity_notes: Two failed attempts, not one - the second is what tells the audience this is not a technique problem.

shots.composition: locked-off static insert of the socket; no movement, no help
shots.camera_motion: locked-off, no movement, no music. Motivation: the most important shot must not be decorated.
shots.character_blocking: off-frame.
shots.midground: the socket: no wick, no oil, no flint
shots.lighting_intention: absolute; one water drop | scene key: black to full amber
shots.action: THE REVEAL. A static shot of the burner's heart: no wick, no oil, no flint. A socket. Cold brass. The exact diameter of a mainspring.
shots.sound_intention: Absolute silence. One water drop.
shots.continuity_notes: The single most important shot in the film. The socket diameter must visibly match the coil in her chest - match it in design at T03.

shots.composition: close-up on the shutter eyes; the aperture closes, then opens
shots.camera_motion: static; the aperture is the only motion. Motivation: the whole decision without a cut.
shots.character_blocking: looks at the socket; looks at her chest; decides.
shots.lighting_intention: her glow low | scene key: black to full amber
shots.action: On WICK. She looks at the socket. She looks at her own empty chest. A long beat - the whole decision, played without a cut.
shots.sound_intention: Her clock motif, stated once, complete, on a single instrument. The only complete statement in the film.
shots.continuity_notes: The complete motif here is the payoff for the fragmented statements since SC01. Do not add strings under it.

shots.composition: macro; unspooling the spring into the socket, unhurried
shots.camera_motion: macro, unhurried. Motivation: the sacrifice is mechanical and must be watched.
shots.character_blocking: unspools her spring; threads it into the socket; gauge 3->1->0.
shots.lighting_intention: the spring sings; the glow fades | scene key: black to full amber
shots.action: She unspools her own mainspring and threads it into the socket. The gauge falls: 3, 2, 1. Then the ratchet engages.
shots.sound_intention: The spring unspooling - a long, thin, singing sound. Then the ratchet engaging. Then her mechanism winding down to nothing.
shots.continuity_notes: The spring is now part of the tower. She cannot be rewound by re-installing it; the ending's single turn is a new beginning, not a restoration.

shots.composition: her dark silhouette held as light blooms to white-gold
shots.camera_motion: held on the silhouette; the bloom fills the frame without a cut. Motivation: the ignition is the payoff.
shots.character_blocking: eyes go dark; the beacon ignites behind her.
shots.lighting_intention: black to full amber - the largest contrast event | scene key: black to full amber
shots.action: Her shutter eyes go dark. A beat of black. Then - IGNITION. The beacon floods the frame until it is white-gold.
shots.sound_intention: One beat of absolute silence. Then the ignition: a huge, warm, low bloom. The score in full, for the first and only time.
shots.continuity_notes: The only full-orchestration moment in the film. Her silhouette must stay readable inside the bloom.

shots.composition: extreme wide held; the beam sweeps black water
shots.camera_motion: locked wide, 8-second protected hold. Motivation: decompression; no coverage.
shots.character_blocking: none.
shots.screen_direction: looks frame R to the sea
shots.lighting_intention: amber shaft in the dark | scene key: dawn rose-gold over wet stone
shots.action: Exterior. The beam sweeps out across black water. Rain turns to light inside the shaft.
shots.sound_intention: The beacon's slow rotation. The sea. Score sustained, no melody.
shots.continuity_notes: The eight-second hold is protected. Do not cut into it for coverage. Beam rotation rate must match SH003.

shots.composition: extreme long lens; the ship tiny; its turn small and easy to miss
shots.camera_motion: held. Motivation: the turn is ponderous; motion would falsify it.
shots.character_blocking: none (the ship).
shots.screen_direction: the ship turns frame L (to harbour)
shots.lighting_intention: dawn edge on the water | scene key: dawn rose-gold over wet stone
shots.action: Far out: the running light. It pauses. Then it turns - toward harbour. The reef line slides past behind it.
shots.sound_intention: The bell buoy, now in rhythm with the beacon. The ship's two-note motif, resolved upward for the first time.
shots.continuity_notes: Reef line and ship bearing must match SC02_SH003 so the audience can read that she turned away from danger.

shots.composition: wide as the light dies, then a slow push to her silhouette
shots.camera_motion: one continuous move: the light dies, the push finds her. Motivation: carry the mood across the cut.
shots.character_blocking: her silhouette at the foot of the burner.
shots.lighting_intention: beacon dims as the dark goes; dawn | scene key: dawn rose-gold over wet stone
shots.action: Dawn comes up grey-gold over the water. The beacon dims as the dark goes. Then: the chamber, dark again, and WICK's silhouette at the foot of the burner.
shots.sound_intention: The beacon winding down. The score thinning to nothing. Dawn birds - the first living sound in the film.
shots.continuity_notes: The beacon dims because the dark is gone, not because it failed. Birds are the only organic sound in the film and start here.

shots.composition: medium held; her shell at the foot of the burner, held long
shots.camera_motion: static, held long enough to be uncomfortable. Motivation: do not soften it.
shots.character_blocking: her shell, slumped, still holding the pole; gauge 0.
shots.lighting_intention: dawn rose-gold | scene key: dawn rose-gold over wet stone
shots.action: Dawn light in the chamber. WICK's shell, slumped at the foot of the burner, still holding the pole. Gauge: 0.
shots.sound_intention: Water dripping. Nothing else.
shots.continuity_notes: Her pose must match the end of SC09_SH003 exactly - this is the same moment, closer.

shots.composition: wide interior; the child a silhouette in the doorway
shots.camera_motion: static from inside the chamber. Motivation: the child is a silhouette, never resolved.
shots.character_blocking: child enters, barefoot, backlit; sees her.
shots.lighting_intention: backlight and rim only | scene key: dawn rose-gold over wet stone
shots.action: Footsteps. A child enters, backlit in the doorway - oversized coat, bare feet, small. Sees her.
shots.sound_intention: Bare feet on wet iron.
shots.continuity_notes: The child is the only human in the film and is never in readable close-up. Backlight and rim light only.

shots.composition: close on the child's hands and the key; the face out of focus
shots.camera_motion: static close on the hands. Motivation: the hesitation is the beat.
shots.character_blocking: kneels; takes the key from her back; hesitates.
shots.lighting_intention: dawn rim on the key | scene key: dawn rose-gold over wet stone
shots.action: The child kneels. Takes the key from WICK's back. Hesitates.
shots.sound_intention: The key lifting out of the back plate - the same small metal sound as the opening.
shots.continuity_notes: Same key asset as SC01_SH001. The hesitation is the emotional beat; give it room.

shots.composition: macro, identical framing to SC01_SH001, warmed to dawn - the loop
shots.camera_motion: locked-off, identical to SC01_SH001. Motivation: the loop; one turn instead of four.
shots.character_blocking: the key turns once; the ratchet catches.
shots.lighting_intention: dawn warm instead of dusk | scene key: dawn rose-gold over wet stone
shots.action: MACRO - mirroring SC01_SH001 exactly. The key turns. One turn. The ratchet catches.
shots.sound_intention: ONE click. Clean, loud in the silence.
shots.continuity_notes: LOOP SHOT: must match SC01_SH001 frame for frame in composition, differing only in colour temperature. One turn, not four.

shots.composition: macro chest drum; the coil catches; the eyes flicker; cut to black
shots.camera_motion: macro, then hard cut to black. Motivation: end on the same click that opened the film.
shots.character_blocking: coil catches; shutter eyes flicker open; needle lifts off zero.
shots.lighting_intention: first amber return in the chest | scene key: dawn rose-gold over wet stone
shots.action: Macro on the chest drum. Inside, the coil catches. The shutter eyes flicker open. The needle lifts off zero. Cut to black on the second click.
shots.sound_intention: The coil catching. The shutter aperture opening. One final click over black.
shots.continuity_notes: FINAL SHOT. Ends on the same click the film opened on, so the film loops. The needle lifts off zero and no further.
